bio.text: Marc Catlin, a Republican, represents District 5 in the Colorado State Senate, covering Delta, Eagle, Garfield, Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose and Pitkin counties.
He has held the Senate seat since January 2025, after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 58) from 2017 to 2025.
He was born in Montrose, Colorado.
His professional experience includes working on his family's farm, working for the Uncompahgre Valley Water Users Association, and hosting a talk radio show on AM KUBC.
